text:
maria (pm): Quick sync — pushing on autofallback UX. want defaults for degrade modes and audit surface before EOD.

alex (eng): open q: should autofallback prefer a cheaper model-variant or do cache/placeholders first?

sam (sre): ops: model-variant then degrade. cache causes stale interactive UX.

jen (design): on UI, show three explicit actions: "Fallback to compatible model", "Serve cached/placeholder", "Return structured error (with retry)". show cost + latency + quality delta.

maria (pm): audit requirement: immutable event for every automatic switch with reason and snapshot metrics + sanitized request sample link.

alex (eng): API sketch (console saves this):
```
policy_name: auto-fallback-v2
triggers: 5xx_pct>0.03, p95>1200ms, quality_drop>5%
actions: [model_variant(gpt-mini-q4), cache(ttl=30s)]
auditable: true
simulate_only: true
max_rate_pct: 5
cooldown_s: 60
```

jen (design): console: simulate toggle, preview last 5 simulated events with small diff chart, "replay" for request recording. breadcrumb the trigger metric + time.

sam (sre): safety: need max-autofallback-rate and cooldown. also backoff windows and global circuit-breaker to prevent oscillation.

alex (eng): API should emit fallback_event with reason_code (e.g., "5xx-surge", "latency-p95"), pre_model_id, post_model_id, and link to audit record.

maria (pm): default behavior: new policy = simulate_only; auto-enable after human signoff or after N successful sims. conservative out of the box.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy auto-fallback-service v1.2 -> healthy

audit-bot: audit-bot: created audit 5029 for simulate run (https://internal/audit/5029)

alex (eng): implementation notes: attach sanitized request sample only when auditable=true. PII scrub + opt-out.

sam (sre): retention: default 90d, recommend configurable up to 365d. add export endpoint (CSV/JSON). Also tests: chaos tests for flapping and integration tests for cooldown logic.

jen (design): I'll mock the audit modal and the fallback timeline with cost/latency overlays.

maria (pm): action items: alex add max_rate_pct, cooldown_s, reason_code to schema + emit audit event. sam propose default guard values + retention. jen deliver two mocks. I'll write RFC for signoff.

alex (eng): will PR tomorrow, include flapping sim test.

sam (sre): scheduling chaos run next week on canary.

maria (pm): thanks, tagging @jen @alex @sam. :rocket:
